newsitem.title: UK: Lloyds up as Unichem renews bid.
newsitem.headline: Lloyds up as Unichem renews bid.

text.p: Shares in Lloyds Chemists gained strongly on Friday after British pharmaceutical chain UniChem said it renewed its bid for the chemists' group.
Lloyds Chemists shares touched a record 523p after the news before slipping back to 518 by 1039 GMT, up 13-1/2p on the day. Almost 1.5 million shares had changed hands.
The broader market was up 0.4 percent.

The Unichem offer values Lloyds Chemists at 657.6 million stg. For every 10 Lloyds Chemists shares, UniChem is offering 16 new UniChem shares and 926p in cash, valuing each Lloyds Chemists share at 505.4p.

Analysts said Unichem's offer held few surprises and predicted Lloyds share would hold steady before Germany's Gehe, also in the running for Lloyds, made its announcement scheduled between 1200 GMT and 1300 GMT.
"We'll have to wait and see what Gehe comes up with. But whatever the outcome, it can only benefit Lloyds," one analyst said.
